text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- King Hassan meets visiting Tunisian Prime Minister Hamed Karoui. Morocco signs trade accord with Tunisia.
- Opposition parties debate draft election law.
- Spain backs U.N. referendum in the Western Sahara.
- Privatisation minister adresses parliament. Opposition parties seek more information on the privatisation process.
- Morocco arrests nine drug traffickers in Tangier.
